draft.subject: a firm like yours
draft.body:
Hi Imogen,

One example. We recently built a private AI system for Wexley Brook Solicitors, a firm much like yours, so their lawyers can search precedents without client data leaving the building.

Happy to send a short write-up by reply if that would help. Shall I?

claims.text: We recently built a private AI system for Wexley Brook Solicitors

evidence.text: Legal Innovation Manager (new role). Lead our work on legal technology, knowledge management and AI adoption across the firm.

facts.wording: Built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture (Legal AI).
The Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) warning notice of 17 August 2026 allows client data into AI tools only with contractual, technical and organisational safeguards.
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.

earlier_steps.body:

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Is this on your radar?

earlier_steps.subject: client data and the SRA
earlier_steps.body:
Hi Imogen,

A different angle. The SRA warning notice of 17 August 2026 allows client data into AI tools only with contractual, technical and organisational safeguards.

Is that shaping how Calloway Shaw chooses its AI tools?
